bio: Tucked away in the lively and bustling city of Bilbao, this gastro-bar is the perfect setting in which to enjoy the true culinary flavour of the Basque Country. Take your pick between an extensive array of tapas and “raciones” and a small menu, but whatever you choose, make sure you try the flavoursome crab-filled scallops, and the entrecôte of aged Frisona Gallega beef. There’s an extensive choice of local wines that the friendly staff will be happy to serve by the glass....
